user.title: Brew Tracker for Pinter
user.description: Choose which notify services get the move-on notifications (for example your phones), and the time of day to send them.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Brew Tracker is already set up.

add_pinter.name: Add a Pinter
add_pinter.description: Add a Pinter (brewing vessel) to the inventory.

remove_pinter.name: Remove a Pinter
remove_pinter.description: Remove an empty Pinter from the inventory.

save_beer.name: Save a beer
save_beer.description: Add a beer to the inventory, or replace one with the same name.

brew_rec.name: Recommended brewing days
brew_rec.description: Filled in when a brew is started.

cond_rec.name: Recommended conditioning days
cond_rec.description: Filled in when a brew is started.

hopper.name: Uses a hopper
hopper.description: The hopper goes in when the dock comes off.

delete_beer.name: Delete a beer
delete_beer.description: Remove a beer from the inventory. Brews already started are not affected.

start_brew.name: Start a brew
start_brew.description: Start a brew of an inventory beer in an empty Pinter. Days default from the beer and can be adjusted.

hopper.name: Uses a hopper
hopper.description: The hopper goes in when the dock comes off.

started.name: Started at
started.description: For a brew that started earlier. Defaults to now.

check_brew.name: Check a brew
check_brew.description: Check whether a brew would clash with the Cold Crashing fridge or be shorter than the beer's minimum.

started.name: Started at
started.description: For a brew that started earlier. Defaults to now.

move_on.name: Move on
move_on.description: Record that a Pinter has been moved on to its next step.

from_step.name: Only if on this step
from_step.description: A stale tap on an old notification then does nothing.

go_back.name: Go back
go_back.description: Undo the last move and put back the earlier step's start time.

send_test_notification.name: Send a test notification
send_test_notification.description: Send the move-on notification for a Pinter, marked TEST, to the chosen notify services.
